articles.title: Bulgaria’s Presidential Race Heads to Runoff as Russia Divides the Two Candidates
articles.dek: After an inconclusive first round to the Bulgarian presidential election, and amid record-low turnout, voters will choose between different views towards Europe and Russia in Sunday’s runoff.

Europe's economy brushes off energy shock from Iran war, shows moderate growth in Q3
articles.dek: Europe's economy persevered with moderate growth in the third quarter despite higher oil prices from the US-Iran war, as gross domestic product increased by 0.4% over the quarter before.

articles.title: Generations of anglers have made the pilgrimage to Montauk to catch striped bass
articles.dek: Generations of fishermen have come to Montauk, New York, to fish for striped bass, but the fish are in the midst of a decline.

articles.title: Germany takes cautious approach on Israeli election results
articles.dek: German politicians have been slow to respond as they wait to see who is likely to comprise the next coalition. Many are also hoping for a government without religious hardliners.

articles.title: For many, striped bass fishing is a way of life. But the iconic species could face collapse
articles.dek: Striped bass are in decline on the East Coast and fishermen and scientists are in a race to save the iconic sport fish.
